title: Statuses: what each does at the engine's fixed hook points
description: Every status ticks down at the end of its owner's turn, including a turn skipped by stun.

on_turn_start.description: Effects run for the owner ("self") as its turn starts

skips_turn.description: on_turn_start: the owner can only pass. Can't be applied to a side that was stunned on its previous turn

absorbs_damage.description: on_damage_taken: stacks soak up damage before HP; the status ends when they run out
